About Oink To Fly

Use your voice to keep a flying pig airborne. Oink To Fly is a playful change of pace from the IQ puzzle collection, combining voice control with a flying adventure through changing scenery.

How to play

  1. Allow microphone access when prompted by the game.
  2. Complete sound calibration and wait until you see GO before starting.
  3. Use your voice to control the pig’s flight.
